description:
Our team is excited to tackle the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge! We aim to bring the stories of NASA's historic, discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars back to life through creative storytelling and engaging visuals. 

I am a Software Developer skilled in coding and web development. 

We are looking for creative team members to join us, especially:

- Storytellers / Writers (to craft the narratives)

- Digital Artists / Designers (for visuals/animations)
summary: "An interactive educational platform that breathes life into forgotten space equipment left on the Moon and Mars. By transforming dry scientific data into engaging, story-driven digital experiences and graphic narratives, we connect young minds with these silent cosmic pioneers, exploring their historical discoveries and inspiring the next generation of space explorers
details:
This combination makes learning more interactive and enjoyable.

6. What factors did your team consider?

Our team considered several important factors:

Target Audience: Designing the experience for children aged 6–12.

Educational Value: Using real space missions and scientific information.

User Experience: Making navigation simple and easy.

Engagement: Combining learning with gaming.

Visual Design: Using attractive space-themed graphics.

Scientific Accuracy: Presenting real missions and their achievements correctly.

Accessibility: Making the websites easy to access through a browser.
